documents.content: Dheeraj Kumar Shukla is a Solution Architect with 14+ years of experience in .NET and ASP.NET Core, Azure/AWS cloud architecture, microservices, API Gateway, CI/CD, and system integration. He specializes in EV charging platforms using OCPI 2.2.1 and OCPP, Beckn protocol (BAP and BPP), IoT messaging with MQTT/RabbitMQ, and ERP integrations with SQL Server and MySQL. He holds Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) and Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104). He is based in Greater Noida, India, and has been a Solution Architect in the EV sector since May 2026; he was previously Technical Architect at TechPerspect Software (ElectreeFi) from August 2023 to April 2026.

Dheeraj Kumar Shukla led OCPI-compliant and Beckn-integrated EV charging platforms serving OEMs, CPOs, and eMSPs across India, integrating 30+ partner networks, maintaining 99% platform uptime and improving interoperability by 20%. He was technical SPOC for Hyundai, Mahindra, Tata, Adani, and Hero MotoCorp. He owned the product lifecycle for the OCPI interoperability platform, including strategy, PRDs, backlog prioritisation, and KPI tracking. He has published 58 engineering and protocol guides covering Beckn (BAP/BPP), OCPI 2.2.1, and OCPP.

Dheeraj Kumar Shukla architected the ElectreeFi EV charging platform, Vendiman and Gobbly smart vending IoT platforms (2000+ devices, 1M+ daily outreach), Xtend Sales global ERP with SAP integration (UAE, UK, USA), and offline-first van sales ERP systems in Dubai.
